mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and SPX returns is positive over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which leads to reduced corporate revenues and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances following a 3-month RSAFS decline, or RSAFS and SPX returns show a positive correlation over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE and SPX returns show a positive correlation over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month indicates supply chain disruptions, which lead to reduced output and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO and SPX returns show a positive correlation over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy with increased consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combined effect of HOUST and UNRATE on SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances following a 3-month PAYEMS increase, or PAYEMS and SPX returns show a negative correlation over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a disinflationary environment, which reduces input costs and increases corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances following a 3-month CPIAUCSL decline, or CPIAUCSL and SPX returns show a negative correlation over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combined effect of GDPC1 and UNRATE on SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
